title: Lightwell v0 implementation: cross-platform image-loading skeleton, then editor
objective: Deliver S0: a native macOS/Windows/Linux skeleton that opens and displays a JPEG, with repeatable setup, lint/build workflows, structured logs, real-render screenshots, agent smoke tests and platform packages. Only after S0, build the retained M1 catalog/geometry/undo/export/live-MCP/manual-Locate editor.
context_summary: Planning only; no app, tooling, VM, build or benchmark was executed. Latest user instruction supersedes the full editor as the first end-to-end build. S0 excludes editing tools, catalogs, export and production IPC/MCP; early agent verification uses a development launch/state/capture harness sharing the real open-image service. Mac M4 is the primary development machine, but S0 completion requires the accepted three-platform launch/load matrix. Rust/Iced/wgpu remains provisional pending narrow probes and product constraints. TASK-002 through TASK-022 retain IDs; TASK-004 and TASK-007 through TASK-022 are M1 follow-on work. TASK-035 through TASK-063 detail S0, with TASK-060 optional and off the completion gate. TASK-064 bridges to M1. Product choices are in tasks/product-decisions.json; explicit local gates verify external decisions before completing. Commands remain empty until real tooling exists. Execution started 2026-09-19: independent fixture and repository-convention work; external S0 gate answers remain outstanding.
